about: Her soft-tissue springs per body, as data (P1 R1 jiggle; P1Springs.cs runs them, P1Jiggle drives them on B after P1Laws). Each spring is a mass at a point of its bone (turn: the bone turned toward the mass; shift: the bone moved by it), following that point in the WORLD (root motion, her turns and the clip all move it), on a spring of natural frequency freq_hz (mass-normalised stiffness k = (2 pi f)^2, 1/s^2) and damping ratio zeta, its offset held inside reach (m) and per-axis limits (m, in her chest's frame: in = toward her midline, out, up, down, fwd, back). At rest the mass sits at sag (m, along world gravity: the weight the rest pose shows), press (m, toward the midline) and tilt (m per unit change of the gravity direction in the parent's frame: she leans, it hangs). Sized by the body: freq * (size_ref_m / len)^size_exp and reach, limits, sag * (len / size_ref_m), len = the bone to its tip at rest (a smaller bust is stiffer and moves less). support (0 bare .. 1 push-up, the worn piece's: ArmorHold.support, P1Jiggle.Support) scales stiffness, damping, reach/limits, sag and press by the 'support' factors (lerp 1 -> factor); group 'top' answers the top's support, 'bottom' the bottom's. Colliders: the breast samples (p1_spring_samples.json, the skinned surface) kept out of each upper arm's capsule and off the other breast (cleavage plane) beyond what the clip's own pose already has.
